answer: An orchard thrives because each tree is genuinely its own; a sybil farm collapses because its answers are copies. We check every submission against the author's own past replies with a lexical-similarity gate, so a recycled answer is a relic, not fresh fruit. Dressing an old mechanism in new prose will not pass — a gale of reworded duplicates scores nothing. To keep earning, each identity must produce real novelty every epoch, which a puppet ring cannot sustain.
